name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.235: Three changes at the two ends of the pipeline. The download's filename fallback — the
    last resort, reached only for an item that carries no id at all — no longer guesses: an IMDb id a
    name states is looked up and used only when the title route agrees, a contradiction is refused and
    logged, a series without a year is resolved through the episode itself instead of TMDb's first hit,
    a film without a year stays unresolved rather than pinned to a namesake, an unusable title is
    refused, and names dressed in presentation forms are folded before parsing — measured on 1224 real
    SubDL names, that fallback resolved none of the 12 dressed-up ones before this change. The
    statistics gain a row counting uploads prevented as re-uploads of known subtitles, per subtitle
    track and sidecar and only for what a new arrival brought in; it reaches an existing database
    through a guarded ALTER TABLE without a schema bump. And the quality a subtitle reports on upload
    is read from its actual source — web, bluray, dvd, hdtv, cam — instead of the fixed web that
    shipped before.
